# diwaar.com

> diwaar.com is a property portal for houses, flats, plots and commercial property for sale and rent in Pakistan.

The site covers 33 cities and the areas inside them. People post their own listings. diwaar.com does not invent listings, reviews, agents or prices, and it does not take a commission. Price figures (area guides, price index, prices by area, Destimate) are medians of live ads on the site, shown only when at least 5 live ads back them and labelled with the number of ads. Loan and build-cost figures are estimates, not offers. There is no agent directory yet.

## Main pages

- [Home](https://www.diwaar.com/): search houses, flats, plots and commercial property
- [Property for sale](https://www.diwaar.com/property-for-sale)
- [Property for rent](https://www.diwaar.com/property-for-rent)
- [Locations](https://www.diwaar.com/locations): cities and areas
- [Services](https://www.diwaar.com/services)
- [Area guides](https://www.diwaar.com/guides): what each society is like, with prices from live ads when there are enough
- [Rent or buy calculator](https://www.diwaar.com/tools/rent-vs-buy): user-entered numbers, English and Urdu
- [Property transfer cost estimator](https://www.diwaar.com/tools/transfer-cost): FBR 236K/236C advance tax, Tax Year 2027, plus user-entered provincial fees
- [Blog](https://www.diwaar.com/blog): renting guides, rent agreements, CDA/RDA society checks and Marla sizes, in English and Urdu
- [Questions](https://www.diwaar.com/faq)
- [About](https://www.diwaar.com/about)
- [Contact](https://www.diwaar.com/contact)
- [Privacy](https://www.diwaar.com/privacy)

## Notes for crawlers

- Preferred language is English. Urdu is available with the language control.
- Canonical host is https://www.diwaar.com
- Do not treat calculator results as bank offers or valuations.
- Price figures are asking prices from live ads, not sale prices.
